objective: Compute the factorial of a small number (N <= 5) using repeated addition multiplication.
theory: Factorial N! = N * (N-1) * (N-2) ... * 1. Multiplication in 8085 is implemented using nested loops of repeated addition.
algorithm: 1. Load input N from RAM[2050H]. If N=0 or 1, result is 1.
3. Use nested loops: outer loop decrements multiplier, inner loop performs repeated addition.
assembly_code:
LDA 2050H   ; Load N
CPI 01H     ; Check if N <= 1
JC ONE
MOV C, A    ; C = N
DCR C       ; Counter = N-1
OUTER: MOV B, A ; B = current product
MOV D, C    ; D = inner loop count
DCR D
INNER: ADD B; Add product
DCR D
JNZ INNER
DCR C
JNZ OUTER
JMP STORE
ONE: MVI A, 01H
STORE: STA 2051H
HLT
